name: azure-kusto-irql-graph
summary: 微软的这项技能接收 KQL 或 IRQL 查询，以及对所需节点和关系的描述。它生成 Lift_To_Graph 映射并组合已存储的 IRQL 函数，以便在 Kusto Explorer 中渲染、折叠或丰富关系图。你可以复用现有的表格查询。通过自然语言指定源查询仅支持简单场景。

Microsoft’s skill takes a KQL or IRQL query and a description of the nodes and relationships you want to see. It generates a Lift_To_Graph mapping and assembles stored IRQL functions to render, fold, or enrich the graph in Kusto Explorer. This lets you reuse an existing tabular query. Natural-language requests for the source query are limited to basic cases.
